push.title: D 3-3 vs Bluecocks BC | You: 9.0 (3rd best match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 9.0 is your 3rd best match performance. Right up there with your very best.

DID WELL
+ 89% passing on 27 attempts, up from your usual 74%. Every ball arrived like it had a GPS.
+ 27 passes (up from your usual 20). You were in the middle of everything, like gravy on mashed potatoes.
+ 3 key passes, the most you've made for us. That's what I call neighborly football.
+ A brace against Bluecocks BC. That's a finish they'll replay at the club banquet.
+ Man of the Match, your 6th for us. Top performer, top teammate.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Repeat after me: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes. Rome, day by day.
- 3 goals conceded cost you 0.1. Next match, keep it simple.

Backyard drill: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

Hey BellyTb1, hold onto this one: Doubt is a guest. Don't give it the spare room.

Champions are made on nights like this. - Coach Lasso

strengths.title: Tackle timing
strengths.note: Wins the ball cleanly and rarely gets beaten in the duel.
strengths.coach: When you went in, you came out with the ball. That's timing.

strengths.detail: Key passes: 3 (top quarter of midfielders: 2+); 1 assist, 3 key passes
strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: 12/22 passes (54%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

coach.closer: Keep that up and I'll have to start buying bigger biscuit tins.

push.title: D 3-3 vs Bluecocks BC | You: 7.9 (3rd best match performance)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 7.9 against Bluecocks BC. A good honest shift, like a well-made chair.

DID WELL
+ Won 2 of 4 tackles (up from your usual 0%). You knew exactly when to go, and you went.
+ 3 key passes, the most you've made for us. That's a pass with a bow on it.
+ That's a partnership I'd build a team around: you and BellyTb1.
+ Your 3rd best match performance (7.9). Keep stacking those.
+ 3-3 draw. Neither team blinked.

WORK ON
- 54% passing (12 of 22). Let's try: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
- 3 goals conceded cost 0.1. One thing at a time.
- 2 shots off target: -0.1. One habit and it's gone.
- Passes attempted: 22. Respectable. Top-quarter midfielders get to 25+, and you've got it in you.
- Tackles attempted: 4. Solid ground. The best midfielders push it to 6+.

Pre-match routine: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.

Hey, tuxedo_slide. Stay humble, hustle hard, hydrate harder.

Learn it, then leave it. - Coach Lasso

A 7.7 against Bluecocks BC, PhogsToffees. Your 8th best match performance. Sturdy work.

Between you and me, PhogsToffees: Practice like you're second, play like you're first.

Keep shining, superstar. - Coach Lasso
